data.name: AzureBlobCredentials_AccountKeyMalformed
data.value: An account key is the base64 text the storage account issued, with no spaces in it; what was given is not one.

data.name: AzureBlobCredentials_SignatureNotAToken
data.value: A shared access signature is the query text the account issued, such as sv=…&sp=…&sig=…, at most {0} characters with no spaces and no address before it; what was given is not one.

data.name: AzureBlobCredentials_SignatureLacksField
data.value: A shared access signature carries '{0}', and this one does not: give the whole token the account issued, from sv= to the end of sig=.

data.name: AzureBlobCredentials_SignatureExpiryUnreadable
data.value: The shared access signature's expiry '{0}' is not a time.

data.name: AzureBlobLocation_AccountInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a storage account name: 3 to 24 lowercase letters and digits.

data.name: AzureBlobLocation_ContainerInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a container name: 3 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or a digit, with no two hyphens together and none at the end.

data.name: AzureBlobLocation_PrefixInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a prefix: folders of lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, separated by '/', none starting with a dot.

data.name: AzureBlobLocation_EndpointNotTheAccounts
data.value: The endpoint '{0}' is not the account's blob endpoint: give a scheme, a host and, where it is not the scheme's own, a port, and at most the account's name as its path — for example https://{1}.objects.example.net, or http://127.0.0.1:10000/{1} for a store on this machine.

data.name: AzureBlobLocation_EndpointInClear
data.value: The endpoint '{0}' is not https. Only a store on this machine is spoken to in clear: anything further away is reached through whoever is in between.

data.name: AzureBlobObjectStore_ObjectTooLarge
data.value: '{0}' is {1} bytes; one request to an Azure Blob container carries at most {2}.

data.name: AzureBlobObjectStore_ListingUnreadable
data.value: The Azure Blob store answered a listing that cannot be read ({0}).

data.name: AzureBlobObjectStore_Unreachable
data.value: The Azure Blob store could not be reached for a {0} after {1} attempt(s): {2}

data.name: AzureBlobObjectStore_Refused
data.value: The Azure Blob store refused a {0} of '{1}': {2} {3}. {4}

data.name: AzureBlobObjectStore_BodyEndedEarly
data.value: The Azure Blob store's answer ended before the blob it was sending did.

data.name: AzureBlobObjectStore_SignatureExpired
data.value: The shared access signature for this container expired at {0} UTC, so nothing was asked of the store under it: store a new one.
